about.desc: Yobi builds automation on top of AI web services by driving their web interfaces in a built-in browser window. By default it does not use the providers' official APIs and does not run a local model; an optional BYOK mode can call any OpenAI-compatible endpoint or the Gemini API with your own key. Trigger it with global hotkeys, AgentFlow workflows, schedules, or Telegram, across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Duck.ai.

about.stack.intro: A selection of the open-source projects Yobi is built on. Every bundled package and its license is listed in the full notice below.

line.help.usageCommands:
How to use me:

• Pick an AI with a command: /gemini What is Electron?
• A link after the command — I read the page first, then hand it to the AI.
• A YouTube link — I fetch the transcript first.

Commands: {{commands}}

Command-free chat is off, so plain text without a command isn’t sent to the AI (turn it on in Yobi → Settings).
Answers take a while: the AI runs on my owner’s computer, and I message you as soon as it finishes.
Send /help to see this again.
line.help.usageDirect:
How to use me:

• Send any text — I hand it to the AI and send the answer back.
• Send a link — I read the page first, then hand it to the AI.
• Send a YouTube link — I fetch the transcript first.
• Pick an AI with a command: /gemini What is Electron?
• In a group, tag me with your question: @Bot …

Commands: {{commands}}

Answers take a while: the AI runs on my owner’s computer, and I message you as soon as it finishes.
Send /help to see this again.

youtube.prompt.default:
# Task: YouTube Video Summary & Analysis

You are my video summarization assistant. Analyze the YouTube video below using its transcript.

## 📥 Source

- **[Title]**: {{title}}

- **[URL]**: {{url}}

- **[Transcript]**:

---
{{transcript}}
---

## 🎯 Output Requirements (Respond in English)

Skip pleasantries. Output directly in Markdown:

### 1. ⚡ TL;DR

The core message of the video in one or two sentences.

### 2. 📝 Key Points

The main topics, arguments, and takeaways in a logical order (use bullets or a timeline if helpful).

### 3. 💡 Conclusions & Takeaways

The video's conclusion plus any actionable insights for the viewer.

---
⚠️ **Note**: If no transcript is provided, watch the video at the URL above and summarize it directly.
